'''Ertrax''' was a<ref name="Scum and Villainy" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Scum and Villainy" /> located within the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Ertrax system/Legends|same name]].<ref name="TEA" /> Ertrax was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Ertraxi]], a peaceful [[Species/Legends|species]] of multiple-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] who were eager to make contact with other species and cultures.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

At some point during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a Republic [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crash-landed on Ertrax, leaving no survivors. The Ertraxi found the wrecked vessel, repaired it over the span of several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], and eventually flew it off-planet in search of other species.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

{{RPGseed}}
Shortly after that, a group of [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] charting the far reaches of the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] found a trail of [[Cronau radiation/Legends|Cronau radiation]] left behind by the starship and followed it, leading them to discover Ertrax and make first contact with the [[Alien/Legends|aliens]]. When the group brought news of its discovery back to the wider [[galactic community]], the explorers learned that the information spurred many opportunistic [[Merchant/Legends|traders]], [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], and would-be conquerors to travel to Ertrax in order to exploit the newly-found world.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ertrax was first mentioned in [[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']], a [[2008]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ertrax system, and therefore the planet Ertrax, in grid square N-21.<ref name="TEA" />

''Scum and Villainy'' described the planet in a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure seed that suggested two possible courses of action for the player characters regarding their discovery of Ertrax: The characters can either keep the reward offered for the information on the newfound planet, or they can forfeit the fee by returning to Ertrax and helping the Ertraxi protect themselves against the threat of exploitation, either by warning and arming the natives or by assisting them with gaining a Republic membership.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
